blocks.text: Buying a 55+ Age-Restricted Townhome in Maple Ridge, BC

parts.t: Downsizers selling a single-family home in Maple Ridge or Metro Vancouver often look for 55+ age-restricted townhomes that preserve single-level rancher living, an attached garage, a private patio or garden, and quiet neighbours—without stairs or exterior yard maintenance. Under British Columbia's Strata Property Act (Bill 44 amendments), 55+ age-restriction bylaws remain 100% legal and enforceable across BC.

Most 55+ townhome communities in Maple Ridge are located on flat, walkable streets in West Central and East Central near Ridge Meadows Hospital (11666 Laity St), the Maple Ridge Seniors Activity Centre (12150 224 St), Haney Place shopping, and transit.

blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Maple Ridge 55+ Senior Townhomes for Sale

parts.t: Are 55+ age-restricted townhome bylaws still legal in British Columbia?

Yes. Under British Columbia's Strata Property Act (as amended by Bill 44), strata corporations are expressly permitted to maintain and enforce a 55-and-over (55+) age-restriction bylaw, even though younger age restrictions (such as 19+ or 45+) were eliminated.
Does every occupant in a 55+ Maple Ridge townhome have to be 55 or older?

Under the BC Strata Property Act regulations, the 55+ age requirement applies to specified occupants, with statutory exemptions for live-in caregivers, and many strata bylaws also include transition or spousal provisions—always verify the exact registered bylaw wording on the Form B.

Can I get a single-level rancher townhome with no stairs in Maple Ridge?

Yes. 55+ complexes in West Central and East Central are the primary source of true single-level rancher townhomes in Maple Ridge, featuring level entries, main-floor laundry, and attached single or double garages.
What is the BC Seniors Property Tax Deferment Program?

Homeowners aged 55 or older who own a principal residence in BC with sufficient equity can apply to the provincial Property Tax Deferment Program to defer annual municipal property taxes at a low simple interest rate until the home is sold.
Are pets allowed in Maple Ridge 55+ townhome communities?

Most 55+ townhome stratas in Maple Ridge allow one dog or one cat (often with a shoulder-height or weight limit), though pet bylaws vary by complex and must be confirmed in the consolidated strata bylaws.
